summary: סרר describes stubborn resistance to rightful rule. The adjective describes a sullen or rebellious person, and Psalm 66 contrasts such people with those who heed God's works.

senses.definition: The rebellious refuse correction and are watched by Yahweh, who rules over the nations.
The adjective describes a person who is stubborn or resentful.

note: סְתָו (o.co.ac), winter, is a correctly separate spelling and is left in its own entry when available. Lam.3.11 סוֹרֵר is analysed under סור and is also left out.
